name: Pearl Coral
description: White branching coral on a pearl mound, two trunks with pale pink tips, about 3 m tall.

name: Nacre Leaf Forest
description: Ten translucent mother-of-pearl leaves up to 4 m tall with thin pearl veins on a pearl mound: the translucent shell forest of the milky sea.

name: Giant Pearl Crystal
description: Six pearly hexagonal crystals with pink points, the tallest 6.5 m, with small pearls at the base.

name: Moulted Husk Arch
description: A giant empty husk forming an arch about 16 m wide and 8 m high: nine ribbed shell arcs joined by a ridge, open at the back. Part of the terrain.

name: Peeling Shell Layers
description: Six old shell plates lifting like pages off a fresh nacre layer, with pink pearls around. The look of the seafloor moulting.

name: Pearl Clam
description: A giant open bivalve about 4 m wide holding five pearls on a nacre floor.

name: Pearl Heap
description: A heap of sixty pearls of mixed size (some pink) on a shadow-coloured base, about 3 m across.

name: Shell-dust Drift
description: A low drift of shell dust about 8 m wide, like snow, with wind lines, shell chips and a few floating motes.

name: White Colonnade
description: A 13 m colonnade of five fluted columns with gold rings, one broken, with a half-fallen beam.

name: White Arch Gate
description: A stone arch gate about 8 m high with a gold keystone and faint jade marks on the pillars. Its makers are left unexplained.

name: White Dome Pavilion
description: A small domed temple about 7 m tall: three steps, eight columns, a gold ring and a gold finial.

name: Terraced Falls
description: Three stacked white rock terraces about 5 m high with thin water curtains running down each step.

name: Shell Spire
description: A tall spiral shell about 8 m high, twelve twisted whorls with pink and nacre rims.

name: Light Curtain
description: Three nested wide translucent light shafts, 25 m high and up to 18 m across, for the soft light that comes from every direction.

name: Shell-dust Current
description: Two translucent bands and 36 specks of dust spiralling 1.4 turns up a 9 m column: the unseen current the dust draws.

name: Moulting Sheet
description: A thin translucent sheet of old shell, 5 m across, peeling off and curling up at one end.

name: Nacre Bubbles
description: Sixteen translucent bubbles of growing size in a loose 4 m column, each with a tiny highlight.

name: Iridescent Veil
description: Three wavy translucent ribbons (white, pink, jade) drifting along 10 m.

name: Pearl Fish
description: One small pearl-white fish 0.5 m long with a gold tail, fins and eyes. Meant to be instanced for ambient schools.

name: Fish Swarm Cloud
description: Seventy small fish in a loose S-shaped flow 14 m long, all heading the same way, no leader. An ordinary school; not a boss body.
